operations.name: bridge_instance_list
operations.summary: List project identities, ownership, users, startup and shutdown states from the shared manager.

operations.name: bridge_instance_status
operations.summary: Inspect instance state, use leases, work, dirty packages, recovery and close blockers without refreshing usage.

operations.name: bridge_instance_ensure
operations.summary: Acquire a shared editor for an exact .uproject; reuse_only and dry_run=true by default.

operations.name: bridge_instance_select
operations.summary: Acquire an existing instance by exact identity or an unambiguous legacy PID/project selector.

operations.name: bridge_instance_release
operations.summary: Release this MCP session's use leases; pending work retains its scope until completion.

operations.name: bridge_instance_close
operations.summary: Preview or request guarded normal exit; other users, dirty packages and in-flight work block close.

operations.name: bridge_instance_reap
operations.summary: Preview or reclaim eligible managed editors; external and protected editors remain owned by their users.

operations.name: bridge_instance_adopt
operations.summary: Explicitly adopt an external editor after verifying project, instance and process creation identity.

operations.name: bridge_instance_pin
operations.summary: Keep a managed editor for a stated reason and a finite duration, at most 3600 seconds.
